# The PDV Timeline
## Quick History
The PDV are an imperial theocratic society that has developed on the desert moon of Pizk, just outside the Colossus Radius. Originally colonists from the Great Confederate Expansion, the PDV were found and oppressed by the small Confederate powers that laid claim to the planet. Eventually, however, an unknown figure wielding advanced technology - bordering on magic - slayed the local government presence, broke the chains of the people, and (unwittingly?) sparked a religious movement that drove the people of Pizk to the stars. Still scarred by the oppression of their old masters, fueled by the sayings of their Savior, and given opportunity from the riches of the Colossus Radius, the PDV are on track to becoming a relevant galactic power.
